listing.summary: This research project is not playable. Reports dated 2026-10-20 show movies, menus and first-level rendering. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA BCUS98232 disc and decrypted EBOOT.ELF. The project describes optional firmware from your own system; this guide does not specify a required update.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s source translation, patch and build instructions and its Python/Tk launcher. This research route is not a completed playable release.
